entities.name: Seelenstone
entities.description: Glowing white stone from Innistrad worshiped in the Priory of the Approaches of Kessig, which stills souls.

entities.name: Priory of the Approaches
entities.description: Priory in Kessig built to house the Seelenstone.

entities.name: Approachers
entities.description: Followers granted the Seelenstone who resisted conversion to the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Nameless Angel
entities.description: Granted the Seelenstone to the Approachers to fight the Bog's influence.

entities.name: Bog Entity
entities.description: Entity whose influence the stone fights and whom Willia ends up serving.

entities.name: Merlinde
entities.description: Prioress who built a full priory.

entities.name: Willia Verlasen
entities.description: Acolyte who guarded the Seelenstone, was corrupted by it and harvested souls.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: What Willia's parents were turned into.

events.summary: The Nameless Angel grants the Seelenstone to the Approachers; a shrine, church, catacombs and priory are built for it.
events.quote: The Seelenstone was granted to the Approachers by the Nameless Angel to fight the influence of the Bog .

events.summary: The stone speaks to Willia, telling her to make it whole by finding other pieces among the people.
events.quote: It began to speak to Willia and told her of power and that she could use it to stop the darkness.

events.summary: Willia argues with her parents and, aided by the stone, kills them and turns them into Whisperers.
events.quote: She didn't mean to kill them.

events.summary: Willia begins harvesting souls, killing villagers and betraying the church's occupants.
events.quote: she had begun harvesting souls, killing the villagers and betraying the occupants of the church.

events.summary: Willia breaks the Seelenstone to release its souls for the Bog Entity.
events.quote: she broke it to release its souls for the benefit of the Bog Entity.

relations.note: released the stone's souls for it
relations.quote: she broke it to release its souls for the benefit of the Bog Entity.
The Seelenstone was granted to the Approachers by the Nameless Angel
